[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kept a '''journal''' of places with great [[Vergence/Legends|connection]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He kept his journal among his other personal records at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the journal was stolen by [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], a member of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]].
